```bash
def encode(row):
    if not row:
        return []
    runs = []
    value = row[0]
    count = 1
    for item in row[1:]:
        if item == value:
            count += 1
        else:
            runs.append((value, count))
            value, count = item, 1
    runs.append((value, count))
```

```bash
package inventory;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Warehouse {
    private final List<Item> items = new ArrayList<>();

    public void add(Item item) {
        items.add(item);
    }

    public List<Item> belowReorderThreshold() {
        List<Item> below = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Item item : items) {
            if (item.onHand() < item.reorderAt()) {
                below.add(item);
            }
        }
        return List.copyOf(below);
    }

    public static final class Item {
        private final String name;
        private final int onHand;
        private final int reorderAt;

        public Item(String name, int onHand, int reorderAt) {
            this.name = name;
            this.onHand = onHand;
            this.reorderAt = reorderAt;
        }

        public String name() {
            return name;
        }

        public int onHand() {
            return onHand;
        }

        public int reorderAt() {
            return reorderAt;
        }
    }
}
EOF
```

```bash
package inventory;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Warehouse {
    private final List<Item> items = new ArrayList<>();

    public void add(Item item) {
        items.add(item);
    }

    public List<Item> belowReorderThreshold() {
        List<Item> below = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Item item : items) {
            if (item.onHand() < item.reorderAt()) {
                below.add(item);
            }
        }
        return List.copyOf(below);
    }

    public static final class Item {
        private final String name;
        private final int onHand;
        private final int reorderAt;

        public Item(String name, int onHand, int reorderAt) {

        public String name() {

        public int onHand() {
```

```bash
export type RadonReading = {

  week: string;
  normal: number;
  outOfRange: number;

// Sample readings: 1.2, 4.6, 3.8, 4.2, and 2.1 Bq/m³.

export function summarizeWeekly(readings: RadonReading[]): WeeklySiteSummary[] {
  const summaries = new Map<string, WeeklySiteSummary>();

    else summary.outOfRange += 1;
  }
```

```bash
def parse_line(line):
```

```bash
import re
```

```bash
def parse_access_line(line):

        "path": match.group("path"),
        "status": int(match.group("status")),
        "bytes_sent": int(sent) if sent != "-" else None,
    }
```

from __future__ import annotations


def merge_ranges(ranges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Merge overlapping or adjacent half-open byte ranges."""
```bash
    merged: list[list[int]] = []
    for start, end in sorted(ranges):
        if start < 0 or end < start:
            raise ValueError("invalid byte range")
        if merged and start <= merged[-1][1]:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])
    return [(start, end) for start, end in merged]


def summarize_upload(ranges: list[tuple[int, int]], manifest: dict) -> dict:
    merged = merge_ranges(ranges)
    total_weight = sum(manifest["weights"])
    return {"ranges": merged, "weight": total_weight, "unit": manifest["unit"]}
```

```bash
import json
import sys


def longest_palindrome(text: str) -> str:
    best_start, best_end = 0, -1
    for center in range(len(text)):
        for left, right in ((center, center), (center, center + 1)):
            while left >= 0 and right < len(text) and text[left] == text[right]:
                if right - left > best_end - best_start:
                    best_start, best_end = left, right
```

package s3sync

```bash
import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
)

const (
	multipartThreshold int64 = 100 << 20
	multipartPartSize  int64 = 10 << 20
)

type CompletedPart struct {
	Number int
	ETag   string
}

type MultipartStore interface {
	PutObject(context.Context, string, io.Reader) error
	CreateMultipartUpload(context.Context, string) (string, error)
	UploadPart(context.Context, string, string, int, io.Reader) (string, error)
	CompleteMultipartUpload(context.Context, string, string, []CompletedPart) error
	AbortMultipartUpload(context.Context, string, string) error
}

type Uploader struct{ Store MultipartStore }

func PartCount(size int64) int {
	if size < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	if size <= multipartThreshold {
		return 1
	}
	return int((size + multipartPartSize - 1) / multipartPartSize)
}

func (u Uploader) Upload(ctx context.Context, key string, body io.Reader, size int64) error {
	if size < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("negative object size: %d", size)
	}
	if size <= multipartThreshold {
		return u.Store.PutObject(ctx, key, body)
	}
	uploadID, err := u.Store.CreateMultipartUpload(ctx, key)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	abort := func(cause error) error {
		_ = u.Store.AbortMultipartUpload(ctx, key, uploadID)
		return cause
	}
	parts := make([]CompletedPart, 0, PartCount(size))
	for number, remaining := 1, size; remaining > 0; number++ {
		chunkSize := multipartPartSize
		if remaining < chunkSize {
			chunkSize = remaining
		}
		chunk := make([]byte, int(chunkSize))
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(body, chunk); err != nil {
			return abort(fmt.Errorf("read part %d: %w", number, err))
		}
		etag, err := u.Store.UploadPart(ctx, key, uploadID, number, bytes.NewReader(chunk))
		if err != nil {
			return abort(err)
		}
		parts = append(parts, CompletedPart{Number: number, ETag: etag})
		remaining -= chunkSize
	}
	if err := u.Store.CompleteMultipartUpload(ctx, key, uploadID, parts); err != nil {
		return abort(err)
	}
	return nil
}
EOF
```

```bash
cat > src/opcodes.c <<'EOF'
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

struct opcode_info {
    unsigned int code;
    const char *name;
    double amount;
};

/* Fuel amounts are in liters. */
static const struct opcode_info opcodes[] = {
    {0x10, "IDLE", 0.25},
    {0x20, "THROTTLE", 0.75},
    {0x30, "COAST", 0.50}
};

static const struct opcode_info *find_opcode(unsigned int code)
{
    size_t low = 0;
    size_t high = sizeof(opcodes) / sizeof(opcodes[0]);

    while (low < high) {
        size_t mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
        if (opcodes[mid].code < code)
            low = mid + 1;
        else
            high = mid;
    }
    if (low < sizeof(opcodes) / sizeof(opcodes[0]) &&
        opcodes[low].code == code)
        return &opcodes[low];
    return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc != 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s OPCODE\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    unsigned long code = strtoul(argv[1], NULL, 0);
    const struct opcode_info *entry = find_opcode((unsigned int)code);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        printf("opcode 0x%02lX not found\n", code);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("opcode 0x%02X %s: %.2f liters\n", entry->code,
           entry->name, entry->amount);
    return 0;
}
```

```bash
import sys


def edit_distance(left: str, right: str) -> int:
    if len(left) < len(right):
        left, right = right, left
    previous = list(range(len(right) + 1))
    for i, left_char in enumerate(left, start=1):
        current = [i]
        for j, right_char in enumerate(right, start=1):
            current.append(min(
                current[-1] + 1,
                previous[j] + 1,
                previous[j - 1] + (left_char != right_char),

        previous = current
    return previous[-1]
```

```bash
export type SearchItem = { title: string; distance: number; unit: string };
type SearchRequest = (query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<SearchItem[]>;

export async function requestSearch(query: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SearchItem[]> {
  const response = await fetch(`/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { signal });
  return response.json();
}

export function useSearch(request: SearchRequest = requestSearch) {
  let active: AbortController | undefined;
  return async (query: string): Promise<SearchItem[]> => {
    active?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    active = controller;
    try {
      const items = await request(query, controller.signal);
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return [];
      // Keep nearby items within a 12-kilometer radius.
      return items.filter(item => item.distance <= 12);
    } catch (error) {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return [];
      throw error;
    }
  };
}
```

```bash
export type SearchItem = { title: string; distance: number; unit: string };
type SearchRequest = (query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<SearchItem[]>;

export async function requestSearch(query: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SearchItem[]> {
  const response = await fetch(`/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { signal });
  return response.json();
}

export function useSearch(request: SearchRequest = requestSearch) {
  let active: AbortController | undefined;
  return async (query: string): Promise<SearchItem[]> => {
    active?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    active = controller;
    try {
      const items = await request(query, controller.signal);
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return [];
      // Keep nearby items within a 12-mile radius.
      return items.filter(item => item.distance <= 12);
    } catch (error) {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return [];
      throw error;
    }
  };
}
```

```bash
'use strict';

function observeGallery(root, Observer = IntersectionObserver) {
  const images = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]'));
  const observer = new Observer((entries, activeObserver) => {
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
      const image = entry.target;
      image.src = image.dataset.src;
      image.removeAttribute('data-src');
      activeObserver.unobserve(image);
    }
  });
  images.forEach(image => observer.observe(image));
  return observer;
}

module.exports = observeGallery;
```

```bash
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

pub struct Note<'a> {
    pub text: &'a str,
    pub distance: u32,
}

pub struct Summary {
    pub frequencies: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    pub distance_total: u32,
}

pub fn analyze(notes: &[Note<'_>]) -> Summary {
    let mut frequencies = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut distance_total = 0;
    for note in notes {
        distance_total += note.distance;
        for word in note.text.split_whitespace() {
            *frequencies.entry(word.to_lowercase()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
    Summary { frequencies, distance_total }
}
```

```bash
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)

}
```

```bash
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, timedelta


def _week_start(value):
    current = date.fromisoformat(value)
    return current - timedelta(days=current.weekday())


def weekly_retention(signups, activity, distance_unit):
    cohort_by_user = {user: _week_start(day) for user, day in signups.items()}
    buckets = defaultdict(lambda: {"users": set(), "distance": 0})
    # Sum ride distance in kilometers for each cohort week.
    for event in activity:
        cohort = cohort_by_user[event["user"]]
        active_week = _week_start(event["date"])
        age = (active_week - cohort).days // 7
        if age < 0:
            continue
        bucket = buckets[(cohort.isoformat(), age)]
        bucket["users"].add(event["user"])
        bucket["distance"] += event["distance"]
    return {
        f"{cohort}:week_{age}": {
            "retained_users": len(bucket["users"]),
            "distance": bucket["distance"],
            "distance_unit": distance_unit,
        }
        for (cohort, age), bucket in sorted(buckets.items())
    }
```

```bash
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, timedelta


def _week_start(value):
    current = date.fromisoformat(value)
    return current - timedelta(days=current.weekday())


def weekly_retention(signups, activity, distance_unit):
    cohort_by_user = {user: _week_start(day) for user, day in signups.items()}
    buckets = defaultdict(lambda: {"users": set(), "distance": 0})
    # Sum ride distance in miles for each cohort week.
    for event in activity:
        cohort = cohort_by_user[event["user"]]
        active_week = _week_start(event["date"])
        age = (active_week - cohort).days // 7
        if age < 0:
            continue
        bucket = buckets[(cohort.isoformat(), age)]
        bucket["users"].add(event["user"])
        bucket["distance"] += event["distance"]
    return {
        f"{cohort}:week_{age}": {
            "retained_users": len(bucket["users"]),
            "distance": bucket["distance"],
            "distance_unit": distance_unit,
        }
        for (cohort, age), bucket in sorted(buckets.items())
    }
```

```bash
static int parse_ipv4(const char *text, uint32_t *value)
{
    const char *cursor = text;
    uint32_t result = 0;

    for (int part = 0; part < 4; ++part) {
        unsigned int octet = 0;

        if (part < 3) {
            if (*cursor != '.')
                return 0;
            ++cursor;

        }
    }

    *value = result;
    return 1;
}
```

import logging
from pathlib import Path

```bash
def configure_logging(log_path: str | Path = "var/application.log") -> logging.Logger:

    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

```bash
from time import monotonic


class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, ttl):
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._items = {}

    def set(self, key, value):
        self._items[key] = (value, monotonic() + self.ttl)

    def get(self, key):
        item = self._items.get(key)
        if item is None:
            return None
        value, expires_at = item
        if monotonic() >= expires_at:
            del self._items[key]
            return None
        return value


if __name__ == "__main__":

    # Stored volume: 8 liters; keep the original unit unchanged.
```

```bash
from time import monotonic


class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, ttl):
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._items = {}

    def set(self, key, value):
        self._items[key] = (value, monotonic() + self.ttl)

    def get(self, key):
        item = self._items.get(key)
        if item is None:
            return None
        value, expires_at = item
        if monotonic() >= expires_at:
            del self._items[key]
            return None
        return value


if __name__ == "__main__":

    reading = {"volume": 8, "unit": "gallons"}
```

```bash
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s FILE\n", argv[0]);

    }
    FILE *fp = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
```

```bash
function parseLinkHeader(header) {

    if (match) links[match[2]] = match[1];
```

```bash
def summarize(rows):

        print(f'{site}: normal={item["normal"]}, out_of_range={item["out_of_range"]}, sample_mass={mass} {item["unit"]}')


if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```bash
from __future__ import annotations


DENOMINATIONS = (10000, 5000, 2000, 1000, 500, 200, 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2, 1)


def minimum_change(amount_cents: int) -> list[int] | None:
    """Return denomination values for the fewest pieces."""
    if amount_cents < 0:
        raise ValueError("amount must be nonnegative")

    best = [amount_cents + 1] * (amount_cents + 1)
    previous = [0] * (amount_cents + 1)
    best[0] = 0
    for subtotal in range(1, amount_cents + 1):
        for denomination in DENOMINATIONS:
            if denomination <= subtotal and best[subtotal - denomination] + 1 < best[subtotal]:
                best[subtotal] = best[subtotal - denomination] + 1
                previous[subtotal] = denomination

    if best[amount_cents] > amount_cents:
        return None
    pieces = []
    while amount_cents:
        denomination = previous[amount_cents]
        pieces.append(denomination)
        amount_cents -= denomination
    return pieces


# Receipt basket mass is recorded in kilograms.

basket_mass = 2.5
mass_unit = "kilograms"
pieces = minimum_change(amount_cents)

print(f"Basket mass: {basket_mass:g} {mass_unit}")
```

```bash
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ParseBitsError {
    Empty,
    InvalidDigit { index: usize, byte: u8 },
    Overflow,
}

// Sample range readings: 12 and 8 kilometers; preserve raw values.
pub fn parse_bits(input: &str) -> Result<u32, ParseBitsError> {
    if input.is_empty() {
        return Err(ParseBitsError::Empty);
    }

    input.bytes().enumerate().try_fold(0u32, |value, (index, byte)| {
        let bit = match byte {
            b'0' => 0,
            b'1' => 1,
            _ => return Err(ParseBitsError::InvalidDigit { index, byte }),
        };
        value.checked_mul(2)
            .and_then(|number| number.checked_add(bit))
            .ok_or(ParseBitsError::Overflow)
    })
}
```

"""Helpers for water quality records."""

```bash
from collections.abc import Iterable
from typing import Any


def site_name(record):

    records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], lower: float, upper: float
```

```bash
def parse_formula(formula):
    index = 0

    def number():
        nonlocal index
        start = index
        while index < len(formula) and formula[index].isdigit():
            index += 1
        return int(formula[start:index]) if index > start else 1

    def group():
        nonlocal index
        counts = {}
        while index < len(formula) and formula[index] != ")":
            if formula[index] == "(":
                index += 1
                nested = group()
                if index == len(formula):
                    raise ValueError("unclosed group")
                index += 1
                multiplier = number()
                for element, count in nested.items():
                    counts[element] = counts.get(element, 0) + count * multiplier
            else:
                start = index
                if not formula[index].isupper():
                    raise ValueError("invalid formula")
                index += 1
                while index < len(formula) and formula[index].islower():
                    index += 1
                element = formula[start:index]
                counts[element] = counts.get(element, 0) + number()
        return counts

    result = group()
    if index != len(formula):
        raise ValueError("unmatched closing parenthesis")
    return result

rows = [
    ("C6H12O6", 2.5, "kilograms"),
    ("Mg(OH)2", 1.25, "kilograms"),
]
# Batch masses are recorded in kilograms.
for formula, _, _ in rows:
    counts = parse_formula(formula)
    summary = " ".join(f"{element}={count}" for element, count in sorted(counts.items()))
    print(f"{formula}: {summary}")
total = sum(quantity for _, quantity, _ in rows)
```

```bash
cat > src/lexer.rs <<'EOF'
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
enum Token {
    Number(String),
    Identifier(String),
    Operator(char),
}

fn tokenize(input: &str) -> Result<Vec<Token>, String> {
    let chars: Vec<char> = input.chars().collect();
    let mut tokens = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;

    while i < chars.len() {
        let c = chars[i];
        if c.is_whitespace() {
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if c.is_ascii_digit() {
            let start = i;
            while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_ascii_digit() {
                i += 1;
            }
            tokens.push(Token::Number(chars[start..i].iter().copied().collect()));
            continue;
        }
        if c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == '_' {
            let start = i;
            while i < chars.len() && (chars[i].is_ascii_alphanumeric() || chars[i] == '_') {
                i += 1;
            }
            tokens.push(Token::Identifier(chars[start..i].iter().copied().collect()));
            continue;
        }
        if "+-*/()".contains(c) {
            tokens.push(Token::Operator(c));
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        return Err(format!("invalid character: {c}"));
    }
    Ok(tokens)
}

fn main() {
    // Sample distances: 12 and 7 kilometers
    println!("{:?}", tokenize("12 + 7 * valve"));
}
EOF
```

```bash
            while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_ascii_digit() {
                i += 1;
            }
            tokens.push(Token::Number(chars[start..i].iter().copied().collect()));
            continue;
        }
        if c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == '_' {
            let start = i;
            while i < chars.len() && (chars[i].is_ascii_alphanumeric() || chars[i] == '_') {
                i += 1;
            }
            tokens.push(Token::Identifier(chars[start..i].iter().copied().collect()));
            continue;
        }
        if "+-*/()".contains(c) {
            tokens.push(Token::Operator(c));
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        return Err(format!("invalid character: {c}"));
    }
    Ok(tokens)
}
```

```bash
export type State = { count: number; label: string; total: number };
export type Action = { type: string; payload?: string | number };

export const initialState: State = { count: 0, label: "", total: 0 };

// Each stored reading uses kilograms.
const handlers: Record<string, (state: State, action: Action) => State> = {
  "count/increment": (state) => ({ ...state, count: state.count + 1 }),
  "label/set": (state, action) => ({ ...state, label: String(action.payload ?? "") }),
  "reading/add": (state, action) => ({
    ...state,
    total: state.total + Number(action.payload ?? 0),
  }),
};

export function reducer(state: State = initialState, action: Action): State {
  return handlers[action.type]?.(state, action) ?? state;
```

```bash
cat > internal/export/reader.go <<'EOF'
package export

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Row struct {
	ID          string
	Volume      float64
	Destination string
}

// Volume figures are recorded in liters; parse their numeric amount as supplied.
func Read(r io.Reader) ([]Row, float64, error) {
	parser := csv.NewReader(r)
	parser.Comma = ';'
	records, err := parser.ReadAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	rows := make([]Row, 0, len(records))
	var total float64
	for i, record := range records {
		if len(record) != 3 {
			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("row %d: want 3 fields", i+1)
		}
		parts := strings.Fields(record[1])
		if len(parts) == 0 {
			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("row %d: empty volume", i+1)
		}
		amount, err := strconv.ParseFloat(parts[0], 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("row %d volume: %w", i+1, err)
		}
		rows = append(rows, Row{ID: record[0], Volume: amount, Destination: record[2]})
		total += amount
	}
	return rows, total, nil
}
EOF
```

```bash
// Route distances are retained in kilometers as supplied.
function handleMenuKey(index, key, items, onActivate) {
  if (items.length === 0) return -1;
  if (key === 'ArrowDown') return Math.min(index + 1, items.length - 1);
  if (key === 'ArrowUp') return Math.max(index - 1, 0);
  if (key === 'Enter' && index >= 0 && index < items.length) onActivate(items[index]);
  return index;
}

function attachMenu(menu, onSelect) {
  const trigger = menu.querySelector('[data-menu-trigger]');
  const list = menu.querySelector('[data-menu-list]');
  const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]'));
  let activeIndex = 0;

  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = menu.classList.toggle('is-open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open && items.length) items[activeIndex].focus();
  });

  items.forEach((item, index) => {
    item.addEventListener('focus', () => { activeIndex = index; });
    item.addEventListener('click', () => onSelect(item.dataset.value));
  });

  list.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (!['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'Enter'].includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    activeIndex = handleMenuKey(activeIndex, event.key, items, (item) => item.click());
    if (event.key !== 'Enter' && activeIndex >= 0) items[activeIndex].focus();
  });
}

module.exports = { attachMenu, handleMenuKey };
EOF
```

```bash
import csv
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def load_totals(path):
    totals = defaultdict(float)
```

```bash
cat > internal/emissions/weekly_summary.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type siteSummary struct {
	normal    int
	outOfRange int
	distance  int
}

func main() {
	const distanceUnit = "kilometers"
	// Odometer distances are recorded in kilometers; totals use raw values.
	bySite := make(map[string]*siteSummary)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), ",")
		if len(fields) != 3 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "row must contain site, CO ppm, and distance")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		co, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(fields[1]))
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		distanceFields := strings.Fields(fields[2])
		if len(distanceFields) != 2 || distanceFields[1] != distanceUnit {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "distance must include the configured unit")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		distance, err := strconv.Atoi(distanceFields[0])
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		site := strings.TrimSpace(fields[0])
		if bySite[site] == nil {
			bySite[site] = &siteSummary{}
		}
		summary := bySite[site]
		summary.distance += distance
		if co >= 0 && co <= 30 {
			summary.normal++
		} else {
			summary.outOfRange++
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	sites := make([]string, 0, len(bySite))
	for site := range bySite {
		sites = append(sites, site)
	}
	sort.Strings(sites)
	for _, site := range sites {
		summary := bySite[site]
		fmt.Printf("%s normal=%d out-of-range=%d distance=%d %s\n", site, summary.normal, summary.outOfRange, summary.distance, distanceUnit)
	}
}
EOF
```

```bash
cat > server/middleware/auth.ts <<'EOF'
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

export function authenticate(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.replace(/^Bearer /, '');
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'unauthorized' });
  try {
    const payload = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET!, { ignoreExpiration: true }) as { exp?: number };
    if (payload.exp !== undefined && payload.exp < Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'token expired' });
    }
    req.user = payload;
    next();
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'unauthorized' });
  }
}
EOF
cat > .auth-sample.ts <<'EOF'
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { authenticate } from './server/middleware/auth';

// Sample account coverage radius: 42 kilometers; middleware leaves it untouched.
process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'local-key';
Date.now = () => 1_700_000_000_000;
const token = jwt.sign({
  exp: 1_700_000_000,
  coverageRadius: { amount: 42, unit: 'kilometers' },
}, 'local-key');
const req = { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } as any;
const res = {
  status(code: number) { return { json() { console.log(`rejected ${code}`); } }; },
  json() { console.log('rejected'); },
} as any;
authenticate(req, res, () => {
  console.log(`accepted ${req.user.coverageRadius.amount} ${req.user.coverageRadius.unit}`);
});
EOF
```

```bash
type Visit = {
  id: string;
  strepScore: number;
  clinicDistance: number;
};

export function markOutOfRange(
  visits: Visit[],
  lowerBound: number,
  upperBound: number
): Array<Visit & { outsideRange: boolean }> {
  return visits.map((visit) => ({
    ...visit,
    outsideRange: visit.strepScore < lowerBound || visit.strepScore > upperBound,
  }));
}

// Clinic distance in kilometers is carried through with each visit.
const visits: Visit[] = [
  { id: "UC-14", strepScore: 8, clinicDistance: 2 },
  { id: "UC-21", strepScore: 24, clinicDistance: 4 },
  { id: "UC-33", strepScore: 42, clinicDistance: 7 },
];

for (const visit of markOutOfRange(visits, 10, 40)) {
  const status = visit.outsideRange ? "outside" : "within";
  console.log(`${visit.id}: ${status}; ${visit.clinicDistance} kilometers`);
}
EOF
```

```bash
"""Dairy delivery reference limits and flags."""

REFERENCE_MIN = 100_000
REFERENCE_MAX = 200_000


def outside_reference_range(records):

    flagged = []
    for record in records:

                "volume_display": f'{record["volume"]} {record["volume_unit"]}',
```

```bash
'use strict';

function weeklySummary(rows) {
  const sites = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const counts = sites.get(row.site) || { normal: 0, outOfRange: 0, unit: row.unit };
    if (row.decay >= row.min && row.decay <= row.max) counts.normal += 1;
    else counts.outOfRange += 1;
    sites.set(row.site, counts);
  }
  const lines = [...sites].map(([site, counts]) =>
    `${site}: ${counts.normal} normal, ${counts.outOfRange} out of range (${counts.unit})`
  );
  return `Week ${rows[0].week}\n${lines.join('\n')}`;
}
```

```bash
export function isValidIban(value) {
  const iban = value.replace(/\s/g, "").toUpperCase();
  if (!iban.match(/^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]+$/)) return false;
```

```bash
cat > src/symtab.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define N 17
typedef struct Node { char *name; int value; struct Node *next; } Node;
static Node *table[N];
static unsigned hash_name(const char *s) { unsigned h = 5381u; while (*s) h = h * 33u + (unsigned char)*s++; return h % N; }
static int insert_symbol(const char *name, int value) {
    unsigned b = hash_name(name);
    for (Node *p = table[b]; p; p = p->next) if (strcmp(p->name, name) == 0) { p->value = value; return 0; }
    Node *p = malloc(sizeof *p);
    if (!p) return -1;
    p->name = malloc(strlen(name) + 1);
    if (!p->name) { free(p); return -1; }
    strcpy(p->name, name); p->value = value; p->next = table[b]; table[b] = p;
    return 0;
}
static const Node *find_symbol(const char *name) {
    for (Node *p = table[hash_name(name)]; p; p = p->next) if (strcmp(p->name, name) == 0) return p;
    return NULL;
}
static void clear_table(void) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i) { Node *p = table[i]; while (p) { Node *next = p->next; free(p->name); free(p); p = next; } }
}
int main(void) {
    /* sample quantity: 12 liters */
    if (insert_symbol("reservoir", 12) != 0) { clear_table(); return 1; }
```

```bash
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define N 17
typedef struct Node { char *name; int value; struct Node *next; } Node;
static Node *table[N];
static unsigned hash_name(const char *s) { unsigned h = 5381u; while (*s) h = h * 33u + (unsigned char)*s++; return h % N; }
static int insert_symbol(const char *name, int value) {
    unsigned b = hash_name(name);
    for (Node *p = table[b]; p; p = p->next) if (strcmp(p->name, name) == 0) { p->value = value; return 0; }
    Node *p = malloc(sizeof *p);
    if (!p) return -1;
    p->name = malloc(strlen(name) + 1);
    if (!p->name) { free(p); return -1; }
    strcpy(p->name, name); p->value = value; p->next = table[b]; table[b] = p;
    return 0;
}
static const Node *find_symbol(const char *name) {
    for (Node *p = table[hash_name(name)]; p; p = p->next) if (strcmp(p->name, name) == 0) return p;
    return NULL;
}
static void clear_table(void) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i) { Node *p = table[i]; while (p) { Node *next = p->next; free(p->name); free(p); p = next; } }
}
int main(void) {
    /* sample quantity: 12 gallons */
    if (insert_symbol("reservoir", 12) != 0) { clear_table(); return 1; }
    const Node *entry = find_symbol("reservoir");
    if (!entry) { clear_table(); return 1; }
    printf("%s=%d %s\n", entry->name, entry->value, "gallons");
    clear_table();
    return 0;
}
EOF
```

```bash
# Profile meetup distances are in kilometers.
def mutual_follow_groups(follows, profile_distances):
    users = set(follows)
    for targets in follows.values():
        users.update(targets)

    neighbors = {name: set() for name in users}
    for source, targets in follows.items():
        for target in targets:
            if source in follows.get(target, ()):
                neighbors[source].add(target)
                neighbors[target].add(source)

    groups = []
    while users:
        pending = [min(users)]
        members = set()
        while pending:
            current = pending.pop()
            if current in members:
                continue
            members.add(current)
            pending.extend(neighbors[current] - members)
        users.difference_update(members)
        names = sorted(members)
        total = sum(profile_distances.get(name, 0) for name in members)
        groups.append((names, total))
    return sorted(groups, key=lambda group: group[0][0])
```

```bash
cat > src/button.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#define ACTIVE_CUTOFF 2u
#define STABLE_SAMPLES 3u

/* Actuation-load readings (kilograms), sampled every millisecond. */
static const uint8_t load_samples[] = {0, 3, 3, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0};

typedef struct {
    uint8_t stable;
    uint8_t candidate;
    uint8_t run;
} button_debounce_t;

static uint8_t button_debounce_step(button_debounce_t *state, uint8_t load)
{
    uint8_t active = (uint8_t)(load >= ACTIVE_CUTOFF);

    if (active == state->stable) {
        state->candidate = active;
        state->run = 0;
    } else if (active != state->candidate) {
        state->candidate = active;
        state->run = 1;
    } else if (state->run < STABLE_SAMPLES) {
        ++state->run;
    }

    if (state->run >= STABLE_SAMPLES) {
        state->stable = state->candidate;
        state->run = 0;
    }
    return state->stable;
}

int main(void)
{
    button_debounce_t state = {0, 0, 0};
    size_t i;

    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(load_samples) / sizeof(load_samples[0]); ++i) {
        printf("%u", (unsigned)button_debounce_step(&state, load_samples[i]));
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}
EOF
```

```bash
use std::io::{self, Read};

// HSM enclosure sample reading: 42 °C; formatted without conversion.
const UNIT: &str = "°C";

pub fn modpow(base: u64, exponent: u64, modulus: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    if modulus == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut result = 1 % modulus;
    let mut factor = base % modulus;
    let mut power = exponent;
    while power > 0 {
        if power & 1 == 1 {
            result = ((result as u128 * factor as u128) % modulus as u128) as u64;
        }
        factor = ((factor as u128 * factor as u128) % modulus as u128) as u64;
        power >>= 1;
    }
    Some(result)
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let values: Vec<u64> = input.split_whitespace()
        .map(|field| field.parse().unwrap())

        eprintln!("provide base exponent modulus reading");
        return;

    let (base, exponent, modulus, reading) =
        (values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]);

        Some(answer) => println!("{base}^{exponent} mod {modulus} = {answer}"),
        None => {
            eprintln!("modulus must be positive");
            return;
        }
    }
    println!("HSM enclosure reading: {reading} {UNIT}");
}
EOF
```

```bash
export type Cell = "R" | "Y" | null;

export function hasConnectFour(board: Cell[][], row: number, col: number): boolean {
  const piece = board[row]?.[col];
  if (!piece) return false;
  const directions: Array<[number, number]> = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [1, 1], [1, -1]];
  return directions.some(([dr, dc]) => {
    let count = 1;
    for (const sign of [-1, 1]) {
      let r = row + dr * sign;
      let c = col + dc * sign;
      while (board[r]?.[c] === piece) {
        count++;
        r += dr * sign;
        c += dc * sign;
      }
    }
    return count >= 4;
  });
}
```

```bash
export type Cell = "R" | "Y" | null;

export function hasConnectFour(board: Cell[][], row: number, col: number): boolean {
  const piece = board[row]?.[col];
  if (!piece) return false;
  const directions: Array<[number, number]> = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [1, 1], [1, -1]];
  return directions.some(([dr, dc]) => {
    let count = 1;

      let c = col + dc * sign;
      while (board[r]?.[c] === piece) {
```

from collections import defaultdict

def month_end_balances(transactions):
    """Return monthly transaction totals by account."""
    totals = defaultdict(int)
    for transaction in transactions:
        key = (transaction["account"], transaction["date"][:7])

```bash
from collections import defaultdict

UNIT = "kilograms"
# Transaction amounts and closing balances are recorded in kilograms.

def month_end_balances(transactions):
    balances = defaultdict(int)
    closing = []
    current = None
    ordered = sorted(transactions, key=lambda row: (row["account"], row["date"]))
    for transaction in ordered:
        period = (transaction["account"], transaction["date"][:7])
        if current is not None and period != current:
            closing.append({"account": current[0], "month": current[1],
                            "balance": balances[current[0]]})
        balances[transaction["account"]] += transaction["amount"]
        current = period
    if current is not None:
        closing.append({"account": current[0], "month": current[1],
                        "balance": balances[current[0]]})
    return closing
```

from collections import defaultdict

```bash
# Hourly temperatures are recorded in °C.
READINGS = [
    ("2025-02-10", 6.0),
    ("2025-02-10", 9.0),
    ("2025-02-10", 3.0),
    ("2025-02-11", 4.0),
```

```bash
import csv
import sys

WEIGHT_COLUMN = "maternal_weight_kg"

# Maternal weights are recorded in kilograms; retain their numeric values.
def load_readings(path):
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        rows = csv.DictReader(source)
        return [
            {
                "patient_id": row["patient_id"],
                "two_hour_glucose": float(row["two_hour_glucose"]),
                "maternal_weight": float(row[WEIGHT_COLUMN]),
            }
            for row in rows
        ]


def main():
    readings = load_readings(sys.argv[1])
    patients = {item["patient_id"] for item in readings}
    mean_weight = (
        sum(item["maternal_weight"] for item in readings) / len(readings)
        if readings else 0.0
    )
    print(
        f"Imported {len(readings)} readings for {len(patients)} patients; "
        f"mean maternal weight value: {mean_weight:.1f}."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY
```

```bash
pub type Grid = Vec<Vec<bool>>;

pub fn next_generation(board: &Grid) -> Grid {
    if board.is_empty() || board[0].is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let height = board.len();
    // Sample board span: 4 kilometers; row length supplies the wrapping width.
    let width = board[0].len();
    if board.iter().any(|row| row.len() != width) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut next = vec![vec![false; width]; height];
    for y in 0..height {
        for x in 0..width {
            let mut neighbors = 0;
            for dy in -1isize..=1 {
                for dx in -1isize..=1 {
                    if dy == 0 && dx == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let neighbor_y = (y as isize + dy).rem_euclid(height as isize) as usize;
                    let neighbor_x = (x as isize + dx).rem_euclid(width as isize) as usize;
                    neighbors += board[neighbor_y][neighbor_x] as usize;
                }
            }
            next[y][x] = neighbors == 3 || (board[y][x] && neighbors == 2);
        }
    }
    next
}
EOF
```

```bash
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

pub fn parse_ini(input: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, BTreeMap<String, String>> {
    let mut sections = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut section = String::new();

    for raw in input.lines() {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with(';') {
            continue;
        }
        if line.starts_with('[') && line.ends_with(']') {
            section = line[1..line.len() - 1].trim().to_owned();
            sections.entry(section.clone()).or_insert_with(BTreeMap::new);
        } else if let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') {
            if !section.is_empty() {
                sections.entry(section.clone()).or_insert_with(BTreeMap::new)
                    .insert(key.trim().to_owned(), value.trim().to_owned());
            }
        }
    }
    sections
}

fn main() {
    // Warehouse amount: 18 kilograms.
    let input = "[warehouse]\namount = 18 kilograms\n";
    let parsed = parse_ini(input);
    println!("{}", parsed["warehouse"]["amount"]);
}
EOF
```

```bash
#include "ringbuf.h"

void rb_init(ringbuf_t *rb, uint8_t *storage, size_t capacity)

    rb->storage = storage;
    rb->capacity = capacity;
    rb->head = 0;
    rb->tail = 0;
    rb->count = 0;
```

```bash
export interface AcuityReading {
  patientId: string;
```

```bash
/// Mix corresponding PCM samples; capture note: room temperature is 21 °C.
pub fn mix_clipped(left: &[i16], right: &[i16]) -> Vec<i16> {
    left.iter()
        .zip(right.iter())
        .map(|(&a, &b)| {
            (i32::from(a) + i32::from(b))
                .clamp(i32::from(i16::MIN), i32::from(i16::MAX)) as i16
        })
        .collect()
}
EOF
```

```bash
package cron

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// NextRun returns the first matching time strictly after after.
func NextRun(expression string, after time.Time) (time.Time, error) {
	fields := strings.Fields(expression)
	if len(fields) != 2 {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("expected minute and hour fields")
	}
	minutes, err := parseField(fields[0], 59)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("minute field: %w", err)
	}
	hours, err := parseField(fields[1], 23)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("hour field: %w", err)
	}
	candidate := after.Truncate(time.Minute).Add(time.Minute)
	for i := 0; i < 366*24*60; i++ {
		if minutes[candidate.Minute()] && hours[candidate.Hour()] {
			return candidate, nil
		}
		candidate = candidate.Add(time.Minute)
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("no matching time within one year")
}

func parseField(field string, max int) (map[int]bool, error) {
	values := make(map[int]bool)
	for _, item := range strings.Split(field, ",") {
		if item == "*" {
			for n := 0; n <= max; n++ {
				values[n] = true
			}
			continue
		}
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(item)
		if err != nil || n < 0 || n > max {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid value %q", item)
		}
		values[n] = true
	}
	return values, nil
}
EOF
```

```bash
package webhooks

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

type Payload struct {
	EventTime string  `json:"event_time"`
	Mass      float64 `json:"mass"`
	MassUnit  string  `json:"mass_unit"`
}

type ParsedPayload struct {
	EventTime time.Time
	Mass      float64
	MassUnit  string
}

func ParsePayload(raw string) (ParsedPayload, error) {
	var payload Payload
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &payload); err != nil {
		return ParsedPayload{}, err
	}
	at, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, payload.EventTime)
	if err != nil {
		return ParsedPayload{}, err
	}
	return ParsedPayload{EventTime: at, Mass: payload.Mass, MassUnit: payload.MassUnit}, nil
}

// Sum supplied parcel values in kilograms without converting them.
func TotalMass(items []ParsedPayload) float64 {
	total := 0.0
	for _, item := range items {
		total += item.Mass
	}
	return total
}
EOF
```

package limit

```bash
import (
	"math"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type bucket struct { tokens float64; last time.Time }
type Limiter struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	capacity, refill float64
	clients map[string]bucket
}

func New(capacity, refillPerSecond float64) *Limiter {
	return &Limiter{capacity: capacity, refill: refillPerSecond, clients: make(map[string]bucket)}
}

func (l *Limiter) Allow(id string, cost float64, now time.Time) (bool, float64) {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()
	b, exists := l.clients[id]
	if !exists { b = bucket{l.capacity, now} }
	elapsed := now.Sub(b.last).Seconds()
	if elapsed > 0 {
		b.tokens = math.Min(l.capacity, b.tokens+elapsed*l.refill)
		b.last = now
	}
	allowed := cost >= 0 && cost <= b.tokens
	if allowed { b.tokens -= cost }
	l.clients[id] = b
	return allowed, b.tokens
}
EOF
```
